request.project_task: Build a visitor parking permit request service.
request.project_goal: Issue time-limited visitor permits without a paper form.
request.project_description: A resident requests a permit for a visitor vehicle and security verifies it.

functional_requirements.text: A resident submits the visitor vehicle plate and visit time.

atoms.text: A resident submits the visitor vehicle plate and visit time.

functional_requirements.text: The system issues a permit when the request is complete.

atoms.text: The system issues a permit when the request is complete.

functional_requirements.text: Security can verify an active permit by plate number.

atoms.text: Security can verify an active permit by plate number.

non_functional_requirements.text: Permit lookup must complete within two seconds.

actors.name: Resident
actors.description: A resident who requests a visitor parking permit.

actors.name: Security Officer
actors.description: Security personnel who verifies active permits by plate number.

use_cases.name: Request Visitor Parking Permit
use_cases.goal: A resident submits a visitor vehicle plate and visit time and receives a time-limited permit.
use_cases.trigger: Resident decides to request a visitor parking permit.

preconditions.text: The resident is identified and authorized to request visitor permits.

success_postconditions.text: A time-limited visitor permit is issued for the submitted vehicle plate and visit time.

failure_postconditions.text: No permit is issued and the resident is informed of the incomplete or invalid request.

main_success_scenario.name: Resident submits complete request and permit is issued

steps.action: Resident submits the visitor vehicle plate and visit time.
steps.expected_result: The system receives the visitor vehicle plate and visit time.

steps.action: The system validates that the request is complete.
The system issues a time-limited visitor permit for the submitted plate and visit time.
steps.expected_result: A permit is issued and associated with the visitor vehicle plate.

steps.action: Resident submits a request missing the visitor vehicle plate or visit time.
steps.expected_result: The system detects that the request is incomplete.

steps.action: The system does not issue a permit and informs the resident that the request is incomplete.
steps.expected_result: No permit is issued; the resident is notified.

user_stories.capability: submit a visitor vehicle plate and visit time
user_stories.benefit: I can request a visitor parking permit without a paper form.

system_stories.system_action: Validate that the submitted visitor vehicle plate and visit time are present and complete.
system_stories.responsibility: Ensure only complete requests proceed to permit issuance.

system_stories.system_action: Issue a time-limited visitor permit for the submitted vehicle plate and visit time.
system_stories.responsibility: Create and persist the permit so it can later be verified.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-001 — Request Visitor Parking Permit
Goal: A resident submits a visitor vehicle plate and visit time and receives a time-limited permit.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: Resident decides to request a visitor parking permit.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC001-001: The resident is identified and authorized to request visitor permits.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC001-001] Resident submits the visitor vehicle plate and visit time.
  2. [STEP-UC001-002] The system validates that the request is complete.
  3. [STEP-UC001-003] The system issues a time-limited visitor permit for the submitted plate and visit time.
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC001-EXC-001: Incomplete request
Source FRs: FR-001, FR-002

use_cases.name: Verify Active Visitor Permit
use_cases.goal: A security officer verifies whether an active visitor permit exists for a given plate number.
use_cases.trigger: Security officer needs to check a visitor vehicle's permit status.

preconditions.text: The security officer is authenticated and authorized to verify permits.

success_postconditions.text: The security officer is shown whether an active permit exists for the plate number.

failure_postconditions.text: The security officer is informed that the permit lookup could not be completed.

main_success_scenario.name: Security verifies an active permit by plate number

steps.action: Security officer submits a vehicle plate number for verification.
steps.expected_result: The system receives the plate number.

steps.action: The system looks up an active permit for the plate number.
steps.expected_result: The lookup completes within two seconds.

steps.action: The system displays the active permit status for the plate number.
steps.expected_result: The security officer sees whether an active permit exists.

steps.action: Security officer submits a vehicle plate number for verification.
steps.expected_result: The system receives the plate number.

steps.action: The system finds no active permit for the plate number.
steps.expected_result: The system reports that no active permit exists.

user_stories.capability: verify an active visitor permit by plate number
user_stories.benefit: I can confirm whether a visitor vehicle is authorized to park.

system_stories.system_action: Look up an active permit by vehicle plate number.
system_stories.responsibility: Provide accurate permit status to security within the required response time.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-002 — Verify Active Visitor Permit
Goal: A security officer verifies whether an active visitor permit exists for a given plate number.
Primary actor: ACT-002
Trigger: Security officer needs to check a visitor vehicle's permit status.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC002-001: The security officer is authenticated and authorized to verify permits.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC002-001] Security officer submits a vehicle plate number for verification.
  2. [STEP-UC002-002] The system looks up an active permit for the plate number.
  3. [STEP-UC002-003] The system displays the active permit status for the plate number.
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC002-EXC-001: No active permit found
Source FRs: FR-003
